rationale: Following the announcement of an all-stock acquisition at a fixed exchange ratio of 0.987 EQT shares per RRC share, RRC is now mechanically tethered to the acquirer's share price and merger arbitrage spread rather than independent supply and demand. Without real-time data on the acquirer's stock, taking an intraday directional position in the target with 47 minutes left in the session carries unquantifiable basis risk. Therefore, passing on the setup is the most prudent decision.
